nc.description: A grey mechanical clamp is gripping a white cylindrical object.
A light grey mechanical component with a cylindrical shaft and a lever-operated central block is shown with a detached circular cap aligned next to its opening.
A grey rectangular pad is connected to a white, angled arm by a silver hinge.
An illuminated, flat rectangular light panel is attached to a white track lighting rail.
A central grey block containing a metallic cylinder is surrounded by a radial arrangement of grey cylindrical rods, an L-shaped rod, and a rectangular piece on a white surface.

vc.description: A grey robotic gripper is holding the ridged lid of a white cylindrical container.
A disassembled mechanical coupling with a knurled handle and locking lever is aligned next to a threaded adapter component on a white background.
A close-up shows a grey textured handle attached to a white plastic base by a hinged joint with an engaged metal locking mechanism.
A grey, clay-like model of a mechanical device featuring a handle, trigger, linkage arms, and a toothed gear is displayed against a white background.
Various unassembled, light-colored mechanical components, including gears, hinges, bolts, and structural profiles, are laid out on a white surface.
